description: Append what an agent did - a tool call, a decision, a message - as a signed, hash-chained entry. This is the thing the workspace is for. Costs 1 unit. Authenticate with the workspace key in _meta[satledger/api-key].

api_key.description: Your workspace key, if your client cannot set _meta[satledger/api-key]. Prefer _meta: arguments are logged by most clients.

detail.description: Anything you want recorded, as an object.
